name: get_provider_info
title: Get Data Source Info
description: Returns metadata about a data source. If no handle is given, the currently selected data source is used.

handle.description: Handle of the data source to query. Defaults to the currently selected one

type.description: Internal type of the data source

size.description: Size of the data source in bytes

is_readable.description: Whether the data source is currently readable. False while an open is still in progress

is_dirty.description: Whether the data source has unsaved changes
